scope: Proposition 15.1 (A weak entropy bound for large marginals) of the manuscript “Conditional information under deterministic coordinate sweeps” (preprints/Conditional-information-under-deterministic-coordinate-sweeps-September-26-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 238 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ad4125b0a60530a3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 61. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is an absolute positive integer C0 such that the following holds for all sufficiently large d ≥ 4. Let µ be the permutation law after C0d layers. If I is a uniform ordered list of 15n/16 distinct input labels, independent of the shuffle, and uI is its uniform injection law, then EID(µI∥uI) = O((1 + d)4 ).
